newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen listed firms up 27 pct so far this year.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen listed firms up 27 pct so far this year.

text.p: The number of companies listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has reached 300 with the issue of two new A shares on Monday, a 27 percent increase since January 1, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
So far this year, 63 firms have floated about three billion shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, raising nearly 20 billion yuan (US$2.4 billion), the newspaper said.
The exchange, set up in late 1990, now has 19.916 billion shares listed from the 300 firms, it said.
Four firms have listed shares on Shenzhen's foreign currency B share market this year, bringing the total of companies with listed B shares in Shenzhen to 47.
